parlay_correlation.method: Gaussian one-factor copula: leg i = sqrt(rho)*Z + sqrt(1-rho)*e_i. P(all legs win) = INT phi(u) * Phi((z_p - sqrt(rho)u)/sqrt(1-rho))^n du, evaluated by 2,001-point Gauss-Hermite quadrature.
parlay_correlation.source: derived arithmetic (see research/parlay-correlation.md for the derivation)

kelly.note: Full Kelly f* = (p*b - q)/b with b = decimal - 1. Negative => no bet.
kelly.source: derived arithmetic (see research/staking.md for the derivation)

walk_forward_model.name: OLS refit weekly: home_margin = a + b * (home point-diff/game - away point-diff/game), fitted ONLY on strictly prior weeks
walk_forward_model.gate_status: FAILS the skill gate by design - see research/validation-gates.md. n is far below the required sample.

full_sample_fit.model: home_margin = a + b * (home point-diff per game - away point-diff per game), fitted on all 121 games with prior data
full_sample_fit.reading: slope near zero and R^2 near zero means season-to-date point differential has almost no linear game-to-game predictive power in this 2026 sample.
